definitions.explanation: A principle or system in which people are evaluated, promoted, or rewarded based on their actual achievements and results rather than seniority, background, or other factors.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実績|じっせき}{主義|しゅぎ}だ。
examples.english: This company operates on a merit-based system.

examples.japanese: {実績|じっせき}{主義|しゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{給与|きゅうよ}→給与：00264_kyuuyo⟧⟦{体系|たいけい}→体系：04487_taikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The introduction of a performance-based system changed the salary structure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{実績|じっせき}{主義|しゅぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More companies are switching from seniority-based systems to meritocracy.

examples.japanese: {実績|じっせき}{主義|しゅぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長所|ちょうしょ}→長所：03121_chousho⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{短期的|たんきてき}な⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Meritocracy has its advantages, but there is also a risk of only chasing short-term results.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧ (actual results; track record) and ⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (-ism; principle). Refers to evaluating people based on what they have actually accomplished rather than on tenure, age, or connections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実績|じっせき}{主義|しゅぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}する→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧: to introduce a merit-based system
- {実績|じっせき}{主義|しゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧: merit-based personnel management
- {実績|じっせき}{主義|しゅぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧: based on meritocracy
- ⟦{徹底|てってい}した→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧{実績|じっせき}{主義|しゅぎ}: thoroughgoing meritocracy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{成果|せいか}{主義|しゅぎ}→成果主義：18880_seikashugi⟧: outcome-oriented approach — nearly synonymous but emphasizes end results more than track record
- ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧: ability-based system — focuses on inherent capability rather than demonstrated performance
- ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧: seniority system — the traditional Japanese system that {実績|じっせき}{主義|しゅぎ} often replaces
